text.p: Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke and Bank of England Governor Eddie George ended their monthly monetary meeting at around 1630 GMT after starting at approximately 1515 GMT.

Because the meeting began after the bank had concluded its daily money market operations, any decision on interest rates is unlikely to become known until the first round of money market operations -- between 0950 and 1000 GMT -- on Thursday.
A Reuters poll of 20 economists last week showed 12 expected no change in official rates from the present 6.0 percent.
